title: Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 — Statute profile
subject: Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990
summary: Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 is a statute of United States enacted in 1990, in the area of disability rights. Prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 101-336.
key_points: Core effect: Prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
